p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-up, investment platforms: official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens up updated official sources, so then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): per product and country, customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if the platform is marked by the regulator before you entrust your money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: The page opens in your own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understanding the document" for the document.For important decisions, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.  24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Commitments and Rules for Almost Every Country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (enterprises importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, permit, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer takes care of everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods, cleared for export, to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risk and cost are at the buyer's expense.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the transport and insurance costs to the port of destination.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller ships to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines Such lists are rejected and can be filed.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the right price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer.It is easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customer’s country: no counterfeit products, no regulated products without approval.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ('wholesale/supplier' listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, delivery, customs duties, VAT in the buyer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the exact delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
